title: Your muscles REMEMBER (even after months off) 🧠💪
caption: Took a long break from the gym? Your muscle fibers kept extra nuclei, so coming back is faster than starting. Have you ever come back after a long break? How fast did it return? 👇
first_comment: Longest break you've ever taken from the gym? Drop it below ⏳
sources: Bruusgaard JC et al. Myonuclei acquired by overload exercise precede hypertrophy and are not lost on detraining. PNAS 2010;107:15111 (mice)
Same paper's intro: women detrained 30-32 weeks after 20 weeks of training lost much of the extra strength and regained it after 6 weeks of retraining (Staron et al. 1991)
Psilander et al. J Appl Physiol 2019 and Cumming et al. 2024: human evidence is partial, so the script says 'in mouse studies'
